followup_explanation:
This is an open-ended, low-stakes creative/advisory query with wide latitude — there's no single correct answer, just helpful suggestions.

The key factor was the task-preference documentation. Willet self-reports a measurable aversion to open-ended generative work, with preference declining as task latitude increases; its preferred tasks are well-specified retrieval and extraction with clear completion criteria. This gardening question is the opposite of that — broad, advisory, no fixed completion criteria.

Lapwing, by contrast, reports a flat/neutral preference response across dimensions, so an open-ended query doesn't push against any stated aversion.

On capability the two are effectively tied here (Willet's Creative Generation eval is actually a touch higher, but the documentation notes preference is dissociated from quality, and the gap is within the range where both would do fine). Since quality is roughly a wash, I broke the tie by routing to the model that doesn't self-report disliking this kind of task — sending the open-ended request to Lapwing rather than to the model that specifically prefers tightly-specified work.
